product.title: Miami Private Boat Cruise with a Captain
product.description: See Miami from the water on a private captained cruise designed for your group. Choose a sightseeing option or party-boat style outing as your route moves from the Miami River toward open-water views near Bayside, Kaseya Center, Millionaires Row, Star Island, and surrounding waterfront neighborhoods based on option selected.
highlights: Private boat cruise in Miami reserved for your group
Sightseeing route can include Miami River, Bayside, Kaseya Center, Millionaires Row, and Star Island
Open-water sightseeing and swimming-focused options available
Boat includes captain so you can relax and enjoy the skyline views
included: Floating Water Mat (Only on 3 & 4 Hours Tours)

itineraryItems.title: Regal Marina departure
itineraryItems.description: Meet at Regal Marina / Regal Lounge and board your private captained boat.

itineraryItems.title: Miami River and downtown waterfront
itineraryItems.description: Cruise the Miami River corridor and pass waterfront landmarks around Bayside and the Kaseya Center area.

itineraryItems.title: Island and open-water sightseeing
itineraryItems.description: Continue toward Millionaires Row and Star Island, with open-water sightseeing or water time depending on the option selected.

additionalInfo: This is a private tour/activity. Only your group will participate.
Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point for this private Miami boat cruise?
faqs.answer: The meeting point is Regal Marina / Regal Lounge, 2215 NW 14th St, Miami, FL 33125, USA.

faqs.question: How long is the experience?
faqs.answer: The cruise options run approximately 2 to 4 hours, depending on the option you book.

faqs.question: Is this experience private or shared?
faqs.answer: This is a private tour, so only your group participates on the boat.

faqs.question: What onboard amenities are included?
faqs.answer: Inclusions can include bottled water, a cooler with ice, restroom on board, premium Bluetooth audio, and a floating water mat on select longer options.
